report: QA Browser Debug: Issue 3 - Do Agent/Task tool calls create duplicate messages in the reducer?
method: Live Playwright inspection of zustand store via Metro module 1259

environment.note: Dev daemon sessions use bypassPermissions/sandbox mode, meaning permissions are auto-approved

verdict: DUAL-MESSAGE THEORY IS REFUTED FOR THIS ENVIRONMENT

finding_1_no_duplicate_message_ids.description: Every Agent tool-call message has a unique ID. No duplicates found in the messages array.
finding_1_no_duplicate_message_ids.conclusion: There are NO duplicate messages for the same tool call in the rendered output.

finding_2_no_permissions_on_any_agent_me.description: ALL 9 Agent tool-call messages have hasPermission=false. No permission data exists on any of them.
finding_2_no_permissions_on_any_agent_me.evidence: permissionIdToMessages: {} (empty object). All 9 messages show hasPermission: false.
finding_2_no_permissions_on_any_agent_me.conclusion: Phase 0 (permission system) did NOT create any messages for these Agent tool calls. This is because dev daemon runs with IS_SANDBOX=1, which bypasses the permission system entirely.

finding_3_one_message_per_tool_id.description: The toolIdToMessageId map has exactly 9 entries, one per Agent tool call. Each toolu_* ID maps to exactly one internal message ID.
finding_3_one_message_per_tool_id.conclusion: Phase 2 found NO pre-existing permission messages, so it created one message per tool call. No collision occurred.

finding_4_sidechain_data_analysis.description: 6 of 9 Agent messages have sidechain data (children). The 3 without children genuinely have no sidechain data in the store.

agents_without_children.note: Still running, sidechain data may not have arrived yet
Still running, sidechain data may not have arrived yet

finding_4_sidechain_data_analysis.conclusion: For agents that have sidechain data, children are correctly linked via realID. The sidechain lookup works: state.sidechains.get(message.realID) returns the correct children array. The 3 agents with 0 children genuinely have no sidechain data (2 are still running, 1 completed without captured sidechain).

finding_5_tool_ids_are_toolu_format.description: All 9 Agent tool call IDs use the toolu_* format, NOT CUID2.
finding_5_tool_ids_are_toolu_format.conclusion: These are Agent tool calls (not Task). Per BA analysis, Agent tools use block.id (toolu_*) in the envelope call field, while Task tools use CUID2. Since this session only has Agent tools (no Task), the CUID2 mismatch bug cannot manifest here.

finding_6_sidebar_shows_generic_view.description: Clicking an Agent tool block opens the detail view showing Description, Input Parameters, and Output -- the generic ToolFullView.
finding_6_sidebar_shows_generic_view.evidence: Screenshot taken: qa-issue3-sidebar-ba-agent.png. Shows 'BA: deep trace Issue 3 Task tool flow' with Description, Input Parameters (JSON blob), and Output sections.
finding_6_sidebar_shows_generic_view.conclusion: The sidebar shows the ToolFullView (generic), not the SidebarAgentConversation (subagent messages). This is by design per the recent code changes that removed Agent/Task from toolFullViewRegistry.

critical_insight.summary: The dual-message theory CANNOT be verified in this environment because dev daemon uses IS_SANDBOX=1
critical_insight.explanation: BA's analysis (ba-issue3-deep-20260407.md) correctly identified that the dual-message bug ONLY manifests in non-sandbox sessions where the permission flow is active. In sandbox mode (IS_SANDBOX=1, which all dev daemon sessions use), Task tools bypass the permission system entirely -- Phase 0 creates NO permission messages, so only Phase 2 creates the tool message. There is no collision because there is no Phase 0 message to collide with.
critical_insight.implication: To verify the dual-message theory, you would need to test in a NON-sandbox session (production-like, where permission flow is active). The dev environment CANNOT reproduce this bug by design.
what_we_CAN_confirm: In sandbox mode, Agent tool calls create exactly ONE message each (Phase 2 only)
Sidechain children are correctly linked via realID when sidechain data exists
The toolIdToMessageId map has no collisions -- one entry per tool call
No permissions are created for ANY tool call in sandbox mode
Agent tools use toolu_* IDs (not CUID2), so the CUID2 mismatch bug only applies to Task tools
what_we_CANNOT_confirm: Whether Task tools (not Agent) create duplicate messages -- no Task tool calls exist in this session
Whether the permission flow creates a Phase 0 message that collides with Phase 2 -- permissions are bypassed in sandbox mode
Whether the dual-message bug causes empty sidebars in production -- we cannot test production

recommendation: The dual-message theory is plausible based on code analysis but CANNOT be confirmed or refuted in the dev environment due to IS_SANDBOX=1 bypassing permissions. To definitively test: (1) Create a test that simulates non-sandbox permission flow in a unit test with the reducer, feeding it both agentState permissions and tool-call-start messages with mismatched IDs, or (2) Check if production sessions (which use real permissions) exhibit the symptom. Since we cannot access production, option (1) is the viable path.
